source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 431 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 431.

PD 431.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 431 was established by Ordinance No. 22683, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 28, 1996. Ordinance No. 22683 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 431 is established on property generally located along the north line of Royal Lane, east of the east line of Abrams Road. The size of PD 431 is approximately 12.278 acres. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 431A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only uses permitted in this district are multifamily uses. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this PD:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise.

-- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Private stable. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.107. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

(a) Front yard. Minimum front yard setback is 15 feet.

(b) Side and rear yard. Minimum side yard setback is 10 feet. Minimum rear yard setback is 15 feet.

(c) Density. Maximum of 340 dwelling units are permitted on the Property.

(d) Floor area. No maximum floor area ratio.

(e) Height. Maximum structure height is 36 feet.

(f) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent.

(g) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is three. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations (Division 51A-4.200) for the specific off-street parking requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Divisions 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Standard Affordable Housing Compliance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.110. STANDARD AFFORDABLE HOUSING COMPLIANCE.

The owner may not apply for a building permit for new construction for a multifamily use unless the owner complies with the density requirements contained in Section 51A-4.116(a)(4)(C)(ii). New construction does not include the following: renovation, remodeling, repair, reconstruction, or enlarging the existing multifamily structures as shown on the development plan. Any increase in the number of dwelling units above that shown on the development plan must comply with the density provisions contained in Section 51A-4.116(a)(4)(C)(ii). The owner may not reconstruct any units destroyed by an intentional act of the owner or his assigns without complying with the density requirements contained in Section 51A-4.116(b)(4)(C)(ii). (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.111. LIGHTING.

All outdoor lighting must be operational and maintained in accordance with the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.112. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plan. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.113. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development plan. Security access gates must be installed at all ingress and egress points within six months after February 28, 1996. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.114. SCREENING.

A minimum eight-foot-high screening wall must be installed as shown on the development plan. A minimum eight-foot security fence must be installed as shown on the development plan. The wall and fence must be installed within six months after February 28, 1996. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.115. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.116. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.117. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.118. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-431.119. ZONING MAP.

PD 431 is located on Zoning Map No. E-9. (Ord. Nos. 22683; 26042)
